sections.title: System Design Walkthroughs
sections.description: Each deck answers one “Design X.” interview question, built up one component at a time.

decks.title: Dropbox
decks.description: File sync at exabyte scale: content-addressed blocks with dedupe, a per-namespace metadata journal with cursors, long-poll notifications, conflicted copies, and erasure-coded storage.

decks.title: Google Docs
decks.description: Real-time collaborative editing: operational transformation, one session owner per document, an op log with snapshots, and offline edits.

decks.title: Google Search
decks.description: A web crawler and search engine: a polite, prioritized crawl loop, a document-partitioned inverted index, scatter-gather over ~1,000 shards with two-phase ranking, PageRank, and a fresh tier for news.

decks.title: Slack
decks.description: Team messaging in real time: tens of millions of WebSockets, strict per-channel order and fan-out, and a database sharded by workspace.

decks.title: Spotify
decks.description: Music streaming from a CDN, adaptive playback, royalties from play events, and a deep dive into the recommendation pipeline.

decks.title: Stripe
decks.description: Card payments without double charges: tokenization into a PCI vault, idempotency keys, an explicit unknown state, a double-entry ledger, and reconciliation against the banks.

decks.title: Ticketmaster
decks.description: Selling a small, contested seat inventory to a huge crowd: seat holds without double-booking, exactly-once checkout, and a virtual waiting room.

decks.title: Twitter / X
decks.description: Home timelines at scale: fan-out on read vs. write, the celebrity problem, real-time search, trends, and ranked For You feeds.

decks.title: Uber
decks.description: Ride hailing: a firehose of driver locations in a geo index, ETA-based batch matching, the trip state machine, surge pricing, and payments.

decks.title: URL Shortener
decks.description: A read-heavy key-value lookup at 300K redirects a second: leased ID ranges scrambled into unguessable base-62 codes, a cache and CDN in front of a sharded store, 302s, and click analytics off the hot path.

decks.title: YouTube
decks.description: Video at planet scale: resumable uploads, a parallel chunked transcode pipeline into a bitrate ladder, adaptive streaming from CDN caches inside ISPs, sharded metadata, and view counting off the hot path.

sections.title: System Design: Deep Dives
sections.description: Each deck zooms in on one component of a system and takes an expanded look at how it works.

decks.title: Rate Limiter
decks.description: Allow or reject in under a millisecond: fixed and sliding windows vs. token buckets, an atomic check in a sharded Redis, rules pushed to every gateway, failing open, hot keys, and limits across regions.

decks.title: Key-Value Store
decks.description: A Dynamo-style store that never refuses a write: consistent hashing with virtual nodes, tunable N/R/W quorums, sloppy quorums and hinted handoff, vector clocks, Merkle-tree anti-entropy, gossip membership, and an LSM-tree storage engine.

decks.title: Message Queue
decks.description: A Kafka-style replicated log: partitions hashed by key, segments and offset indexes, leaders and followers with an ISR and high watermark, KRaft failover with leader epochs, consumer groups and rebalancing, retention, compaction, tiered storage, and exactly-once with idempotent producers and transactions.

decks.title: Ad Click Aggregator
decks.description: Counting a firehose of clicks by time window: log first, tumbling and sliding windows in event time, watermarks and late events, exactly-once with checkpoints and idempotent upserts, top-K with heaps and count-min sketches, and lambda vs. kappa with an exact batch recount for billing.
